note: The bands the Extreme Flight 67 in CAP 580 plant has to land in, from docs/CAP580-STAGE1.md, which derives each from Extreme Flight's data sheet, T-Motor's measured bench table for the AM670 520 kV on the 18 x 8, APC's 18 x 8E data, the photographs of the aircraft and momentum theory (npm run cap580:derive prints the derived figures and fails when a `derived` here is not its own). Each width is the Extra 300 3D's for the same gate (tests/extra-thresholds.json), because the quantity carries the same kind of estimate; where the CAP's input is measured and the Extra's estimated, the width is no wider. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

c1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle on the plant's thrust line and drag polar, derived 30.32; 12 percent either way, the Extra's: the thrust is measured here but cd0 is the Extra's estimate Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, T-Motor's 21.55 V at 111.1 A on 6S, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat; npm run cap580:derive -- --write-bands): derived 30.32, was 27.69; the same 12 percent.

c2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 10.62 at the sheet's 8 lb on 860 sq in and the wing's CL max at the stall's own Reynolds number, 2.5e5 on the mean chord: 0.928, from Timmer's measured NACA 0018 (0.988 at 1.5e5, 1.056 at 3e5) times Raymer's 0.9 (plant_wing.c stall_re), as the Extra's; alphaStall is that CL max over the wing's own slope, 0.928 / 4.543. The Extra's band in proportion, 0.94 to 1.14 of the formula

c3_glide.source: L/D at 15 m/s, derived 7.43, 12 percent either way, the Extra's

c4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 35.51 where APC's 18 x 8E curve (scaled to the bench's static thrust) meets the drag; 10 percent either way, the Extra's Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, T-Motor's 21.55 V at 111.1 A on 6S, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat; npm run cap580:derive -- --write-bands): derived 35.51, was 33.06; the same 10 percent.

c5_roll.source: pb/2V at full aileron on the high rate, Clda throw_a / -Clp, derived 0.4397 (533 deg/s at 18 m/s); 25 percent either way, the width Roskam's K' carries, the Extra's

c6_hover.source: hanging on the prop, the height held by the throttle, gated on the measurement: T-Motor's bench table lifts the 3.63 kg at 0.535 throttle (between its 50 and 55 percent rows), 5 percent either way, the Extra's E6 width. The plant turns the stick into the prop's speed by the bench's own rpm curve (throttle_rpm, cap580:derive), so its stick is where that speed, sqrt(W / T_static) of full, falls on the curve: derived 0.514; the 4 percent between the two is the bench's thrust not going exactly as the square of its rpm Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, T-Motor's 21.55 V at 111.1 A on 6S, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat; npm run cap580:derive -- --write-bands): the bench's 0.535 was flown on its own supply, 23.58 V at 13.4 A sagging to 21.55 V at 111.1 A (docs/CAP580-STAGE1.md); the same thrust on the gates' 4.1 V pack takes less stick, the derivation's 0.455, and the band is 5 percent about that (was 0.509 to 0.562 about the bench's 0.535). The bench's figure stays written beside it.

c7_vertical.source: straight up at full throttle, where the thrust line meets the weight and the zero lift drag, derived 25.89; 10 percent either way, the Extra's Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, T-Motor's 21.55 V at 111.1 A on 6S, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat; npm run cap580:derive -- --write-bands): derived 25.89, was 24.03; the same 10 percent.

c8_torque_roll.source: hanging at the hover throttle with the ailerons let go and the nose held on the rudder: the bench's 2.097 N m over its 94.3 N times the weight, 0.79 N m, less the wing root's share of the swirl (1 - SWIRL_KEEP, Selig, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), 0.51 N m net (the fin's counter roll goes with the side force the held rudder cancels, cap580:derive), against the air the turning airframe sweeps through (rot_k roll), derived 182 deg/s to the left; 25 percent either way, the Extra's. The fin meets the swirl the static jet brings it, slip_loss[2] (Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, figs. 15a and 15b; ~/Desktop/fdfpv-loop/research/wash-speed/WASH-SPEED.md), and SWIRL_KEEP holds Selig's 0.40 at 0.65 (was 0.74); was 194, the band 146 to 242.

c9_aileron_hover.source: the same with full right aileron: the aileron's inboard share in the wash, 1.03 N m, beats the net torque, derived 182 deg/s right; 40 percent either way, the Extra's, the difference of two estimates. The fin meets the swirl the static jet brings it, slip_loss[2] (Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, figs. 15a and 15b; ~/Desktop/fdfpv-loop/research/wash-speed/WASH-SPEED.md), and SWIRL_KEEP holds Selig's 0.40 at 0.65 (was 0.74); was 169, the band 102 to 237.

c10_zero_speed.source: hanging still, full up elevator and full right rudder from rest: the wash's dp on the surfaces' immersed shares, saturating on a flat plate (hi_alpha), derived 20.18 rad/s^2 in pitch and 10.3 in yaw; 25 percent either way, the Extra's. With the prop stopped the same sticks give under 5 percent of it The tail meets dp less the static jet's spread, slip_loss (Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, figs. 15a and 17a; ~/Desktop/fdfpv-loop/research/wash-speed/WASH-SPEED.md): on the whole far wake it was 27.47 and 14.91.

c11_harrier.source: level at 40 deg of angle of attack, the throttle holding height: the stalled wing's plate lift and the thrust's vertical share against the weight, derived 7.89 m/s at 0.41 throttle (re-derived on the prop curve, w35-cap580-ctj; was 0.497) with the elevator at 56 percent of its throw; the speed 20 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, the Extra's, and the elevator short of full. The rock's size from the only harrier data held, the 3D video's (analysis/3D-VIDEO-LESSONS.md, V4 and the 05:16 tile): a Night Timber X, a different airframe of the same class (foam 3D), its elevator flaps mix off, rocks 15 to 30 deg (read at 10 fps, bank plus or minus 10 deg for the camera); no CAP specific harrier data exists, as the Extra's E11 judges it. Was bank under 10, the Extra's, which had no source. C11b: AS3X, the receiver the CAP flies with, damps it, its bank spread under Manual's Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, T-Motor's 21.55 V at 111.1 A on 6S, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat; npm run cap580:derive -- --write-bands): the throttle derived 0.41, was 0.467; the same 15 percent. The speed, 9.798 m/s, does not move. The height hold now starts at dutyDerived, the throttle the derivation levels it at, where it started at 0.58 with no source: a pilot sets the throttle the harrier needs, and 0.58 on the seated pack climbed out of the entry and left Manual's rock damped by its transient (C11b compared AS3X with a Manual run that had stopped rocking). C11b re-posed 2026-10-12 (w37-heading-margins, lead decision): the full Heading is now measured, the largest that keeps 6 dB and 45 deg everywhere, and on the CAP it is about none (0.0083, 0.0169, 0.0046): measured full Heading about 0 on this airframe, its dampers on their margin. C11b flies it there and records the bank's spread against Manual's (6.7 against 4.9 deg); only the height is judged.

c12_knife_edge.source: rolled to 90 deg at 20 m/s, height held on the rudder: the fuselage and fin lifting sideways with the crossflow drag and the thrust's share along the yawed axis, derived 31.73 deg of sideslip at 0.557 throttle with the rudder at 78 percent of its throw; the sideslip 25 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, the Extra's, and the rudder short of full Re-derived 2026-10-12 with the fuselage's crossflow on its drawn rounded box section, not a round body's: NACA TN 3038 Table I, the 1:2 ellipse 1.6 and the 1:1 rounded square at r/b 0.333 1.0 over the same tunnel's circle 1.0 (scripts/lib/crossflow.js), was 32.25 deg at 0.624; the same widths about it. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, T-Motor's 21.55 V at 111.1 A on 6S, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat; npm run cap580:derive -- --write-bands): the throttle derived 0.555, was 0.622; the same 15 percent. The sideslip, 29.87 deg, does not move. Re-derived 2026-10-13 (w38-fuselage-side) with the fuselage's share of the weathercock, -0.0366 of 0.1997, on Munk's sin 2 beta (NACA TR 184, plant_wing.c MUNK'S MOMENT) where it was on sin beta: was 29.87 deg at 0.555; the same widths about it (cap580:derive --write-bands). Re-derived 2026-10-13 (w38-crossflow-moment) with the fuselage's crossflow drag acting at its own centre of pressure, side_x ahead of the CG, Allen and Perkins' crossflow on the drawn sections (NACA TR 1048; plant_wing.c side_x, ESTIMATED), where it acted at the CG, -0.129 m: was 30.24 deg at 0.556; the same widths about it (cap580:derive --write-bands).

c13_rest.source: at rest on the photographed gear, 10.87 deg nose up (IMG_7289 reads 9 to 13), the CG 0.313 m up, 16.9 percent of the weight on the tailwheel; half a degree, 5 mm and 3.5 points either way, the Extra's

c14_takeoff.source: full throttle from standing, the tail up past 6 m/s and the nose to 8 deg at 1.2 times the stall: liftoff at 12.7 m/s after 4.2 m (cap580:derive); 40 percent short and 60 long, the Extra's Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, T-Motor's 21.55 V at 111.1 A on 6S, through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat; npm run cap580:derive -- --write-bands): derived 3.641 m, was 3.838; the same 40 percent short and 60 long. Liftoff re-defined 2026-10-13 (w38-hover-yaw), the band and the derivation unchanged: sustained flight, the last step on the wheels with none after it and the CG 2 m over it, where it was the last step on the wheels before 200 ms clear of them. At full throttle on its tail the CAP hops off its wheels at 7 m/s and comes back (168 ms before w38-hover-yaw, 272 ms after it), which the 200 ms clear read as liftoff at 1.16 m once the hop passed 200 ms. Measured old to new definition: 5.53 m at 15.31 m/s both, on the plant before and after.

c17_figures.source: the figure judge (src/game/figuredetect.js), fed every plant step as main.js feeds it on a fixed wing, names the 3D figures C6, C8, C11 and C12 fly, the knife edge by the wing in the vertical plane (FAI F3P-AA 23) at C12's 30 deg of sideslip: what Free Flight's callouts and a Trick Battle room score

stab_straight.source: thrown level at 16 m/s, 75 percent, every stick centred in Stabilised: the cross track after 10 s, right negative as the plant's y. The derivation (cap580:derive throwFlight) flies the throw whole: the right thrust's turn, the motor's torque at the throw (the prop started at its duty's speed and spooled on Drela's law, the rotor's acceleration and the air's torque on the mount) rolling it 1.93 deg left at 0.5 s before Stabilised's roll loop and its integrator (ArduPilot's RLL2SRV_I, TCONST and IMAX) level it, which turns the path back left, the 2 deg trim pitch's climb and the thrust it takes, the swirl on the fin and the root, its force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, as plant_wing.c takes it), the jet normal force, the P factor and the prop's gyroscope: derived -9.42 m. Against the plant: the bank within 0.01 deg at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 s, the heading within 0.01 deg, the cross track within 0.06 m along the curve and 0.01 m at 10 s (-9.43 m on w36-physics); with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.15 m of the derived -19.37 m. Held within 0.3 m either way: the worst agreement of the two, 0.15 m, and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain over the flight, the explicit step). Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the combined plant (w36-physics): the swirl's force at speed on the whole stream (Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), the static swirl's spread at the fin (slip_loss[2], figs. 15a and 15b), SWIRL_KEEP 0.65 (was 0.74) and the controls on dp less the jet's spread put in the derivation; was derived -17.78 m within 0.4 (the worst agreement then 0.19 m), the plant -17.76 on w36-cap-straight. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source, red at -17.8 m since the right thrust went in (2026-10-12). Re-derived 2026-10-13 (w38-fuselage-side) with the fuselage's share of the weathercock on Munk's sin 2 beta (NACA TR 184): was -9.42 m; the same width about it (cap580:derive --write-bands). Re-derived 2026-10-13 (w38-crossflow-moment) with the fuselage's crossflow drag acting at its own centre of pressure, side_x ahead of the CG, Allen and Perkins' crossflow on the drawn sections (NACA TR 1048; plant_wing.c side_x, ESTIMATED), where it acted at the CG: was -9.38 m; the same width about it (cap580:derive --write-bands).
